title: taskloom Configuration
description: Schema for taskloom's own config.yaml files (~/.taskloom/config.yaml and the per-project .taskloom/config.yaml), layered via internal/shared/confload exactly like ctxloom's own config-schema.json.

homing.description: Where the project's task-store log is homed. "home" keeps it PRIVATE under ~/.ctxloom/tasks/<project-id>.jsonl (today's default behavior; never committed, never shared by a clone). "repo" checks the log into the project tree at .taskloom/tasks.jsonl, alongside this config file, so it is SHAREABLE and travels with clones. taskloom refuses to guess: this key (at either the home or project config layer), the TASKLOOM_CONFIG_HOMING environment variable, or the --homing flag must set it before any command that touches a single project's store will run.

tag_schema.description: Tag-schema declarations, each written in tagma's own tag syntax, asserting a facet over a tag key used on this project's tasks — e.g. `tagma.arity:"triage:kind"=scalar`. Facets: `arity` (a target declared `=scalar` may carry at most one tag with that (namespace, key) per task, and taskloom's write seam collapses a re-tag onto it — the newest value survives; the log still records both the retracting untag and the new tag, so history is never rewritten); `priority_fn`/`decay_fn` (`tagma.priority_fn:"<target>"="<mustache-equation>"`, `tagma.decay_fn:"<target>"="<mustache-equation>"` — mustache-form formulas EVALUATED read-time by internal/shared/tasks/priority.Compute against every task's tag values plus taskloom-provided built-ins like age_days; exactly one of each may be declared across every target, or `taskloom list --sort priority`/`task_list`'s sort="priority" fails loud); `enum` (`tagma.enum:"<target>"="a,b,c"` — a closed value vocabulary `taskloom lint` checks a tag's value against); `range` (`tagma.range:"<target>"="min,max"` — a numeric [min,max] bound `taskloom lint` checks a tag's value against, and implies the value must parse as a number); `hide` (`tagma.hide:"<target>"=<bool>` — display-time-only tag hiding, never enforced at write time or affecting storage/matching/ranking). See internal/shared/tasks/tagschema, internal/shared/tasks/priority, and internal/shared/tasks/lint. This key replaces the WHOLE list at whichever layer sets it last (home < project < TASKLOOM_CONFIG_* env < --config-set) — it is never merged element-by-element. Unset at every layer falls back to taskloom's built-in triage-classification baseline: `triage:kind`/`triage:effort`/`triage:blocks-release` declared scalar (`triage:kind` is a work-kind enum — defect/capability/chore; `triage:effort` is a 0-5 range; `triage:blocks-release` is free-form, e.g. a semver, only ever presence-tested); `triage:exposed` also declares an enum (wire/cli/config/on-disk/api) without being scalar. Priority is DERIVED from a handful of independently-checkable factual flags (`triage:crashes`, `triage:data-loss`, `triage:no-workaround`, `triage:security=<cwe>`, `triage:regression=<version-or-sha>`, `triage:blind-gate=<gate>`, `triage:exploited-in-wild`) rather than a hand-assigned severity score, plus that baseline's own priority_fn/decay_fn declarations on `triage:kind`.
